page.overview:
Who is Mayday?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2| G.I. Joe Extreme

Mayday was planned for release as a basic figure in the G.I. Joe Extreme line in 1996. Ultimately, she was not produced. She (along with planned Rampage and Wreckage figures) can be seen on the back of the packaging for Black Dragon and Harpoon. ---- Appearance:

Accessories: Blue and white convertible all-terrain ski backpack.

---- [https://www.yojoe.com/action/other/extreme/unproduced/figures.shtml YoJoe.com page]
